rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: The 12th leader election was announced today (14 January 2022) at 10:00, with filings closing at 15:00.

rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: 福島みずほ現党首 filed with the recommendation of the Kanagawa federation and 387 members; no one else sought to stand.

rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: She was re-elected unopposed; after receiving the certificate of election 福島党首 held a press conference.

rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: After receiving the certificate, 福島党首 thanked the members and stated the party's role at a press conference.

rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: The notice says the convention planned for 19-20 March would approve the result, after which 福島瑞穂党首's new term was to begin.
